To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the N400 ERP component reflects a semantic process that is common to both linguistic and action-related material, and that this process is instantiated by the interplay of fronto-temporo-partial regions.
the N400 and the Action N400 reflect the same underlying mechanism, the building of meaning in context.
the N400 ERP component, originally associated with the semantic processing of language, can also be observed during the comprehension of action events.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the neural correlates of the semantic processing of actions.
the question of what the N400 is and why the N400 occurs.
how the human brain builds meaning in the context of actions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the N400 is a general-purpose neurocognitive mechanism for meaning construction.
the N400 and the N400 for actions are two different manifestations of the same mechanism.
the N400 is an index of meaning processing in the human brain, regardless of the type of information (e.g., language, action, or other types of information).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the N400 is a marker of meaning, and that this marker is used by the brain to build meaning in context, whether it is a context of words or of actions.

the N400 reflects a general mechanism that is not specific to the processing of linguistic stimuli, but that is instead involved in the construction and updating of meaning across different domains, including the processing of action information.

the N400 reflects a mechanism of semantic integration that can be recruited in the service of action comprehension, as well as language comprehension, and that the brain regions involved are the same.
The main takeaway from our work is that

action comprehension is not just the simple integration of the different components that constitute the event, but it involves a more complex process that is based on the creation of a mental simulation of the action and the integration of the event into the current situation and previous experiences.
action comprehension is not a unitary process, but is instead composed of different sub-processes that are differentially modulated by the contextual factors.
the N400 is a useful tool for the investigation of the neural underpinnings of action semantics.
